subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Intricate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intricate** means very complicated or detailed. (जटिल)

 
 
• **Example:** The watch mechanism is extremely **intricate** and requires careful handling.
 
 
 
• **Simple** means easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty. (सरल)
 
 
• **Example:** His explanation of the concept was so **simple** that even a child could understand it.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Simple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Harmony** (सामंजस्य): the quality of forming a pleasing and consistent whole.

 
 
• **Example:** We must strive to live in harmony with nature.
 
 
 
• **Blocked** (अवरुद्ध): obstructed or not allowed to progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The road was blocked due to the landslide.
 
 
 
• **Complex** (जटिल): consisting of many different and connected parts.
 
 
• **Example:** The plot of the novel is quite complex and full of twists.
 
 

31:Tcc2,
